content.short: KINETK watermarks creator content and tracks where it is used across the web.
content.description: KINETK applies watermarks to creator content and follows where that content subsequently appears, building an intellectual property layer on Monad. Provenance for media has become considerably more pressing now that generated content is indistinguishable at a glance from the original.
